decisions.briefing: Stocks fell broadly today, with the NASDAQ down 1.1% and the S&P 500 down 1.2%, so the screener returned no buy candidates. The portfolio stays at 7 positions and about $546 in cash. The automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules will handle exits, so no positions were sold just because of one down day.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell across the board today, with the S&P 500 down 1.2% and the NASDAQ down 1.1%. The drop was broad and not limited to tech, which suggests investors cut risk across the market rather than reacting to news about one sector. No news headlines came with today's data, so the specific cause can't be confirmed here, and treating the session as risk-off is the cautious choice.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全線下挫，標普500指數跌1.2%，納斯達克指數跌1.1%。跌勢並非集中於科技板塊，而是普遍性回落，反映資金整體降低風險，而非針對單一行業消息作出反應。由於今日數據並無附帶新聞標題，未能確認具體誘因，因此審慎起見，將今日視為避險（Risk-Off）交易日。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors sell riskier assets like stocks and move toward safer places such as cash or bonds, so most of the market falls together. On days like this it is usually wiser to hold off on new buys than to try to catch falling prices. Pre-set stop-losses can protect existing positions if the decline keeps going.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者拋售股票等高風險資產，轉投現金或債券等較安全的資產，令大市普遍同步下跌。在這類日子，暫緩建立新倉通常比急於「接飛刀」更為明智。若跌勢持續，預先設定的止蝕位可為現有持倉提供保障。
